prompt:
Create a TWELVE-POSE SPRITE SHEET of the SAME character in image 1. Image 1 is identity, clothing and illustration style reference: preserve this exact person's recognizable face, age, hair, build and identical clothing. Image 2 is the EXACT 12 poses and layout reference; replace its mannequins with this character, not the mannequin anatomy. Image 3 is visual novel sprite-sheet STYLE reference for matching the project.
STRICT LAYOUT: wide canvas, exactly SIX COLUMNS by TWO ROWS, exactly TWELVE separate knee-up figures. Same scale, equal head tops and knee cutoffs by row. Generous truly TRANSPARENT gutters all around EACH figure, no touching neighbors. All hands, elbows and hair fully included. Leave large transparent gutter between rows. No ground shadows, no text, labels, frames, extra figures or props.
EXACT POSE ORDER row 1 left to right: 1 neutral arms down, 2 hands loosely clasped in front, 3 one hand on hip, 4 arms casually crossed, 5 one hand near chin thoughtful, 6 relaxed slight weight shift arms down.
Row 2 left to right: 7 one open palm explaining gently at chest level, 8 both hands behind back, 9 one hand holds opposite wrist in front, 10 hand touching back of neck, 11 one forearm across abdomen other down, 12 both palms open slightly outward.
Natural normal adult proportions. Identical character and outfit in every cell, expression subtly varies but eye anatomy coordinated with same gaze. Carefully drawn normal hands/fingers, no extra arms or detached hands. The original single-pose reference is NOT permission to repeat its same pose 12 times. Follow all 12 mannequin gestures.
Style: fine detailed pixel-art illustration, crisp small square clusters, natural adult face, layered soft tones, exactly like these supplied VN sprites. No smooth photorealism, anime, chibi, vector or giant coarse mosaic.
TRUE RGBA transparency outside silhouettes, absolutely NO colored glow, blur, gradient, black/white matte or checkerboard. Clean natural-colored alpha edges with no neon fringes. Head-to-knees framing in each cell, full silhouettes except deliberate uniform knee cutoff.
